ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

checkbox-group.description: Form control for multiple selection with native inputs, select-all, min/max validation, layouts, sizes, and states.

examples.note: A set of related options with an array value. Children inherit size and density from the group.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the checkbox group components.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

select-all.note: The select-all checkbox reflects the group: unchecked when empty, indeterminate when partial, checked when all enabled options are selected.

size-density.note: Size and density propagate to every child through the group token; a child keeps its own values when set explicitly.

checkbox-group.title: Checkbox Group

validation.note: Min and max selected bounds invalidate the group. Max only validates in v1; it does not block selection.
